{
  "project_id": "P-SRB-CompetitivenessJobs",
  "risks": [
    {
      "risk_id": "R01",
      "description": "Failure to establish a functional inter‑ministerial policy planning, monitoring and coordination (PPMC) system.",
      "category": "organizational",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Create a legally mandated PPMC working group, define clear mandates, provide capacity‑building workshops and enforce semi‑annual reporting.",
      "evidence": "No Competitiveness and Jobs policy planning, monitoring, or coordination framework exists (DLI 1 description)."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R02",
      "description": "Insufficient procurement capacity in the Public Policy Secretariat (PPS) and line ministries causing procurement delays.",
      "category": "organizational",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Hire experienced procurement specialists, deliver intensive Bank‑led procurement training, and implement a monitoring checklist for all procurements.",
      "evidence": "PPS does not have adequate capacity in Bank‑funded projects and with Bank procurement procedures."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R03",
      "description": "High overall procurement risk may lead to contract award delays and cost overruns.",
      "category": "organizational",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Adopt a detailed procurement plan with clear timelines, use pre‑qualified bidders, and conduct regular procurement progress reviews.",
      "evidence": "Overall project risk for procurement is rated “high”."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R04",
      "description": "Disbursement‑Linked Indicators (DLIs) not met, resulting in delayed or withheld loan disbursements and cash‑flow pressure.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 5,
      "mitigation": "Establish a DLI tracking unit within the PIU, conduct quarterly DLI readiness assessments, and prepare contingency action plans for shortfalls.",
      "evidence": "If a DLI is not achieved, the Bank can issue a waiver and determine amount and timing of withheld disbursement."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R05",
      "description": "Overlapping mandates and lack of coordination among investment and export promotion agencies reduce program efficiency.",
      "category": "organizational",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Implement agency restructuring with clear legal mandates, introduce joint performance targets, and set up a shared monitoring dashboard.",
      "evidence": "Agencies have overlapping mandates, no coordination, and unclear links with broader economic policy goals."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R06",
      "description": "Restructuring of Ministry of Economy agencies may disrupt ongoing support services during transition.",
      "category": "organizational",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Phase restructuring steps, maintain interim service units, and monitor service continuity indicators throughout the transition.",
      "evidence": "Restructuring could include combination of existing or creation of new agencies."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R07",
      "description": "Matching Grants Program may fail to attract required private co‑financing, limiting leverage of public funds.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Set minimum co‑financing thresholds in grant agreements, provide technical assistance to firms for co‑financing arrangements, and monitor uptake quarterly.",
      "evidence": "Matching grants require at least 30% private sector co‑financing."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R08",
      "description": "Technology Transfer Facility (TTF) funding insufficient to build a viable tech‑transfer pipeline.",
      "category": "technical",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Secure additional donor contributions, prioritize high‑potential projects, and establish performance‑based milestones for transaction completion.",
      "evidence": "Current TTF funding (Euro 1.18 million) is deemed insufficient to finance and demonstrate a strong tech transfer pipeline."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R09",
      "description": "High caseload per NES case worker limits effective job matching and employer outreach.",
      "category": "organizational",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Reallocate staff, introduce active‑job‑seeker registry, and set caseload caps with regular monitoring of workload distribution.",
      "evidence": "Average caseload varies between around 200 to over 2,000 registered unemployed per case worker."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R10",
      "description": "Certification and training of NES case workers may not be completed within the 12‑month target.",
      "category": "schedule",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Develop a detailed training calendar, assign dedicated trainers, and track certification progress monthly.",
      "evidence": "Case workers must be certified within 12 months from appointment."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R11",
      "description": "High tax wedge and benefit withdrawal disincentivize formal employment for social assistance beneficiaries.",
      "category": "political_regulatory",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 5,
      "mitigation": "Design an in‑work cash transfer that offsets lost benefits and tax contributions, and pilot the scheme before scaling.",
      "evidence": "High tax wedge on low‑paying jobs and social assistance benefit reduced by at least one dinar for every dinar earned."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R12",
      "description": "Macroeconomic instability and high public debt may constrain fiscal space for project activities.",
      "category": "external",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Align project expenditures with the medium‑term fiscal strategy, and include fiscal contingency buffers in the budget.",
      "evidence": "Public debt to GDP ratio sharply increased from 36% in 2009 to over 70% in 2014."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R13",
      "description": "Perceived high level of corruption could affect procurement integrity and stakeholder confidence.",
      "category": "political_regulatory",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Enforce public disclosure of all contracts, conduct independent audits, and implement a whistle‑blower mechanism.",
      "evidence": "Perceived level of corruption in the country is high."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R14",
      "description": "Lack of robust monitoring and evaluation systems hampers evidence‑based policy adjustments.",
      "category": "technical",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Build a centralized M&E platform, train staff on data collection, and conduct periodic independent evaluations.",
      "evidence": "Lack of robust monitoring and evaluation systems; not clear what outcomes of programs are."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R15",
      "description": "Dependence on external technical assistance may lead to delays if consultants are not secured on time.",
      "category": "external",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Prepare detailed TORs early, use pre‑qualified consultant pools, and include penalty clauses for late delivery.",
      "evidence": "Total TA needs are estimated at around EUR 3 million; additional details of Innovation component TA are included."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R16",
      "description": "Manual entries in the centralized payroll system could introduce data errors or unauthorized changes.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Implement automated validation rules, conduct quarterly payroll audits, and enforce segregation of duties with audit‑trail reviews.",
      "evidence": "Changes in the payroll are entered manually; IT system generates logs, but the logs are not reviewed."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R17",
      "description": "Environmental and social safeguards may be insufficiently monitored, risking non‑compliance with ESMF requirements.",
      "category": "environmental",
      "likelihood": 2,
      "impact": 2,
      "mitigation": "Engage the independent E&S expert to conduct quarterly compliance checks and publish safeguard monitoring reports publicly.",
      "evidence": "An Independent Environmental and Social Expert will be engaged to ensure compliance with the ESMF."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R18",
      "description": "Implementation of the PPMC framework may experience schedule slippage due to need for frequent adjustments.",
      "category": "schedule",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Set a phased rollout plan with fixed milestones, and allocate a contingency buffer for adjustment activities.",
      "evidence": "The framework will be a work‑in‑progress, requiring frequent adjustment and improvement."
    }
  ]
}

risks.description: Failure to establish a functional inter‑ministerial policy planning, monitoring and coordination (PPMC) system.
risks.mitigation: Create a legally mandated PPMC working group, define clear mandates, provide capacity‑building workshops and enforce semi‑annual reporting.
risks.evidence: No Competitiveness and Jobs policy planning, monitoring, or coordination framework exists (DLI 1 description).

risks.description: Insufficient procurement capacity in the Public Policy Secretariat (PPS) and line ministries causing procurement delays.
risks.mitigation: Hire experienced procurement specialists, deliver intensive Bank‑led procurement training, and implement a monitoring checklist for all procurements.
risks.evidence: PPS does not have adequate capacity in Bank‑funded projects and with Bank procurement procedures.

risks.description: High overall procurement risk may lead to contract award delays and cost overruns.
risks.mitigation: Adopt a detailed procurement plan with clear timelines, use pre‑qualified bidders, and conduct regular procurement progress reviews.
risks.evidence: Overall project risk for procurement is rated “high”.

risks.description: Disbursement‑Linked Indicators (DLIs) not met, resulting in delayed or withheld loan disbursements and cash‑flow pressure.
risks.mitigation: Establish a DLI tracking unit within the PIU, conduct quarterly DLI readiness assessments, and prepare contingency action plans for shortfalls.
risks.evidence: If a DLI is not achieved, the Bank can issue a waiver and determine amount and timing of withheld disbursement.

risks.description: Overlapping mandates and lack of coordination among investment and export promotion agencies reduce program efficiency.
risks.mitigation: Implement agency restructuring with clear legal mandates, introduce joint performance targets, and set up a shared monitoring dashboard.
risks.evidence: Agencies have overlapping mandates, no coordination, and unclear links with broader economic policy goals.

risks.description: Restructuring of Ministry of Economy agencies may disrupt ongoing support services during transition.
risks.mitigation: Phase restructuring steps, maintain interim service units, and monitor service continuity indicators throughout the transition.
risks.evidence: Restructuring could include combination of existing or creation of new agencies.

risks.description: Matching Grants Program may fail to attract required private co‑financing, limiting leverage of public funds.
risks.mitigation: Set minimum co‑financing thresholds in grant agreements, provide technical assistance to firms for co‑financing arrangements, and monitor uptake quarterly.
risks.evidence: Matching grants require at least 30% private sector co‑financing.

risks.description: Technology Transfer Facility (TTF) funding insufficient to build a viable tech‑transfer pipeline.
risks.mitigation: Secure additional donor contributions, prioritize high‑potential projects, and establish performance‑based milestones for transaction completion.
risks.evidence: Current TTF funding (Euro 1.18 million) is deemed insufficient to finance and demonstrate a strong tech transfer pipeline.

risks.description: High caseload per NES case worker limits effective job matching and employer outreach.
risks.mitigation: Reallocate staff, introduce active‑job‑seeker registry, and set caseload caps with regular monitoring of workload distribution.
risks.evidence: Average caseload varies between around 200 to over 2,000 registered unemployed per case worker.

risks.description: Certification and training of NES case workers may not be completed within the 12‑month target.
risks.mitigation: Develop a detailed training calendar, assign dedicated trainers, and track certification progress monthly.
risks.evidence: Case workers must be certified within 12 months from appointment.

risks.description: High tax wedge and benefit withdrawal disincentivize formal employment for social assistance beneficiaries.
risks.mitigation: Design an in‑work cash transfer that offsets lost benefits and tax contributions, and pilot the scheme before scaling.
risks.evidence: High tax wedge on low‑paying jobs and social assistance benefit reduced by at least one dinar for every dinar earned.

risks.description: Macroeconomic instability and high public debt may constrain fiscal space for project activities.
risks.mitigation: Align project expenditures with the medium‑term fiscal strategy, and include fiscal contingency buffers in the budget.
risks.evidence: Public debt to GDP ratio sharply increased from 36% in 2009 to over 70% in 2014.

risks.description: Perceived high level of corruption could affect procurement integrity and stakeholder confidence.
risks.mitigation: Enforce public disclosure of all contracts, conduct independent audits, and implement a whistle‑blower mechanism.
risks.evidence: Perceived level of corruption in the country is high.

risks.description: Lack of robust monitoring and evaluation systems hampers evidence‑based policy adjustments.
risks.mitigation: Build a centralized M&E platform, train staff on data collection, and conduct periodic independent evaluations.
risks.evidence: Lack of robust monitoring and evaluation systems; not clear what outcomes of programs are.

risks.description: Dependence on external technical assistance may lead to delays if consultants are not secured on time.
risks.mitigation: Prepare detailed TORs early, use pre‑qualified consultant pools, and include penalty clauses for late delivery.
risks.evidence: Total TA needs are estimated at around EUR 3 million; additional details of Innovation component TA are included.

risks.description: Manual entries in the centralized payroll system could introduce data errors or unauthorized changes.
risks.mitigation: Implement automated validation rules, conduct quarterly payroll audits, and enforce segregation of duties with audit‑trail reviews.
risks.evidence: Changes in the payroll are entered manually; IT system generates logs, but the logs are not reviewed.

risks.description: Environmental and social safeguards may be insufficiently monitored, risking non‑compliance with ESMF requirements.
risks.mitigation: Engage the independent E&S expert to conduct quarterly compliance checks and publish safeguard monitoring reports publicly.
risks.evidence: An Independent Environmental and Social Expert will be engaged to ensure compliance with the ESMF.

risks.description: Implementation of the PPMC framework may experience schedule slippage due to need for frequent adjustments.
risks.mitigation: Set a phased rollout plan with fixed milestones, and allocate a contingency buffer for adjustment activities.
risks.evidence: The framework will be a work‑in‑progress, requiring frequent adjustment and improvement.
